newsitem.title: INDIA: At least six injured in India blast on bus.
newsitem.headline: At least six injured in India blast on bus.

text.p: At least six people were injured in a blast on a bus near the Red Fort in the old quarter of the Indian capital on Monday, police said.
"There has been a blast on a bus. We do not know if it was a bomb," a police spokesman told Reuters. "At least six people are injured."
He said no other details were immediately available. The blast occurred close to a neighbourhood where four people were injured on Saturday when inflammable chemicals exploded on a bus.
Thirty-three people were killed and 64 injured last week when a powerful bomb exploded on a train in the nearby state of Punjab, which was rocked by a Sikh separatist movement in the 1980s.
